name: NajdiKit
description: Sub-millisecond Modern White Saudi & Urban Najdi Arabic phonetics (TTS G2P/tashkeel), STT post-processing, lexicon lookup, and LLM style grounding.

pythonBin.description: Optional Python 3 executable path (defaults to python3).

customLexiconPath.description: Optional path to an external user lexicon JSON overlay.

personalAdapterJson.description: Optional path to a private runtime STT personal adapter JSON.

localLlmUrl.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible local MLX server URL for contextual homograph disambiguation.
